Overview

Fairbanks is a city in AK with a population of 32,000. Interior Alaska’s largest city, known for northern lights, gold rush history, and extreme winters. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 2a growing zone supports Very cold — hardy perennials only. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.6.
